name: Technical Brief
description: A dark technical brief: a near-black green-grey room, panels one step up from the ground with a single hairline border and no shadow, a monospace uppercase eyebrow in bright teal trailed by a thin rule, dash-marked lists under a coloured pip label, monospace tabular numbers, and a teal hairline progress bar along the top edge. Teal is the working accent; emerald and amber mark the second and third card of a triple, and amber alone means a caveat. Ported from the author's own hand-written 1280x720 architecture deck, geometry x1.5; every face is a system font, because a projector is not guaranteed to have a network and a failed web font falls back silently.

paper.use: page background: the source deck dark mode ground, a near-black green-grey

surface.use: panel and card background: one step up from the ground, a 1px hairline border and no shadow

line.use: the visible hairline: the eyebrow rule, the footer rule, table header rules, meta separators

linesoft.use: the quieter hairline: card borders, table row rules, chip borders

faint.use: footer rail, page numbers, card labels, list dashes and small print

accent.use: the working accent: eyebrows, numbers, the progress bar, keywords, the first card pip

accentsoft.use: the accent tint: highlighted panels, the interface layer of a diagram

accent2.use: emerald: the core-logic layer of a diagram, accent chips, the second card pip

accent2soft.use: emerald tint: accent chip ground, core-logic nodes

violet.use: violet: the persistence layer of a diagram and the dashed derivation path

slate.use: slate: external tools in a diagram, the layer that is not ours

alert.use: amber, reserved for caveats and limits: the left bar of a callout, the third card pip, measurement-boundary frames

alertsoft.use: amber tint: the ground of a caveat callout

display.family: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Microsoft JhengHei", "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif

body.family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Microsoft JhengHei", "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif

vocabulary: a monospace uppercase eyebrow in teal, trailed by a hairline that runs to the right margin
panels one step up from the ground: a single 1px hairline border, an 8px radius, no shadow and no gradient
a card label as a small coloured pip followed by faint monospace capitals — teal, emerald then amber across a triple
list items marked by a short horizontal dash, not a bullet
monospace tabular numbers in teal, sized by the layout
monospace chips on a sunken ground with a hairline border and a 4px radius
caveats as a callout: an amber left bar 3px wide on an amber tint, square on the left and rounded on the right
a cover meta grid: five columns divided by vertical hairlines, a faint small-caps label over a monospace value
a footer rail: a hairline above monospace small print, the page source on the left and the page number on the right
a 3px teal progress bar along the very top edge, filled to the current page
diagram layers coded by colour: teal for interfaces, emerald for core logic, violet for persistence, slate for external tools, amber dashes for a measurement boundary
avoid: shadows, glass and gradients on panels: this pack is flat and hairline-bordered
rounded pill cards and radii above 8px, except the progress bar and chips
serif faces and any web font: every face is a system font
colour used decoratively: teal is the accent, violet and slate label diagram layers, amber only ever means a caveat
filling a gap with a plausible-looking value: an empty slot stays empty
